title: Present Continuous
summary: Talk about what is happening right now, or around now — "She is working from home today", "I am learning English".
whyThisTopic: It's how you say what's happening as you speak — and knowing when to use it instead of the present simple is what stops English sounding stiff.

assessmentConfig._note: Temporarily 2 for faster testing — production value is 3. questionsPerSubSkill and qualifyingScore must move together: if qualifying > drawn, nobody can ever skip a sub-skill.

blocks.text: প্রশ্ন করতে **am / is / are** subject-এর আগে চলে আসে; বাকি সব একই থাকে। এখানে **do / does** ব্যবহার হয় না — **Are you working?** ঠিক, **Do you working?** ভুল। **What / Where / Why** থাকলে সেটি সবার আগে বসে: **What are you doing?**

feedback.en: That's a statement with a question mark. In a question, **am / is / are** comes before the subject.
feedback.bn: এটি প্রশ্ন নয়, শুধু শেষে প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন। প্রশ্নে **am / is / are** subject-এর আগে বসে।

feedback.en: **Do / Does** is for the present simple. This question starts with **Am / Is / Are**.
feedback.bn: **Do / Does** present simple-এর জন্য। এই প্রশ্ন শুরু হয় **Am / Is / Are** দিয়ে।

feedback.en: Correct. **Is** moves in front of the subject, and nothing else changes.
feedback.bn: ঠিক আছে। **Is** subject-এর আগে চলে আসে, বাকি সব একই থাকে।

feedback.bn: প্রশ্নেও verb-এ **-ing** থাকে।

blocks.text: Use the **present continuous** for what is happening now or around now. Use the **present simple** for habits and things that are always true.
right now / at the moment / today

rows: I am working from home today
They are playing at the moment

items.text: I am helping my brother today.
We watch this show every week.
She is watching it right now.

blocks.label: Watch out
blocks.text: Some verbs describe a state, not an action: **know, want, like, need, understand**. They stay in the present simple — say **I know it**, never *I am knowing it*.

blocks.label: ব্যাখ্যা
blocks.text: এখন বা আজকাল যা ঘটছে তার জন্য **present continuous**; অভ্যাস বা সবসময় সত্য এমন কিছুর জন্য **present simple**। **every day**, **every morning**-এর মতো শব্দ থাকলে বুঝবেন এটি অভ্যাস। **know, want, like, need, understand** — এগুলো অবস্থা বোঝায়, কাজ নয়, তাই এগুলোতে **-ing** বসে না।

options.text: Be quiet — the baby is sleep.

feedback.en: After **am / is / are**, the verb takes **-ing**.
feedback.bn: **am / is / are**-এর পরে verb-এ **-ing** যোগ হয়।

feedback.en: The **-ing** verb can't stand alone. It needs **am**, **is**, or **are** in front of it.
feedback.bn: **-ing** verb একা বসতে পারে না — এর আগে **am / is / are** লাগে।

options.text: Be quiet — the baby is sleeping.

feedback.en: Correct. This is happening as you speak, so the present continuous is right.
feedback.bn: ঠিক আছে। এটি এখনই ঘটছে, তাই present continuous সঠিক।

feedback.en: The present simple is for habits. This is happening **now**, so use **am / is / are** + **-ing**.
feedback.bn: present simple অভ্যাসের জন্য। এটি **এখন** ঘটছে, তাই **am / is / are** + **-ing** ব্যবহার করুন।

options.text: My father is driving to work every day.

feedback.en: A repeated time phrase like **every day** signals a habit — that takes the present simple, not **-ing**.
feedback.bn: **every day**-এর মতো শব্দ অভ্যাস বোঝায় — সেখানে present simple বসে, **-ing** নয়।

options.text: My father drives to work every day.

feedback.en: Correct. A repeated habit takes the present simple.
feedback.bn: ঠিক আছে। অভ্যাস বা নিয়মিত কাজ present simple-এ হয়।

options.text: My father drive to work every day.

feedback.en: In the present simple, **he / she / it** and single things take **-s** on the verb.
feedback.bn: present simple-এ **he / she / it** ও একবচনের সাথে verb-এ **-s** বসে।

options.text: My father driving to work every day.

feedback.en: A habit doesn't use **-ing** at all. Adding **is** wouldn't help — use the present simple form of the verb.
feedback.bn: অভ্যাস বোঝাতে **-ing** ব্যবহার হয় না। **is** যোগ করলেও ঠিক হবে না — present simple form ব্যবহার করুন।

options.text: I am want a cup of tea.

feedback.en: These verbs need no **am / is / are** and no **-ing**. Just **I want**, **she needs**.
feedback.bn: এই verb-গুলোর সাথে **am / is / are** বা **-ing** কিছুই লাগে না — শুধু **I want**, **she needs**।

options.text: I am wanting a cup of tea.

feedback.en: **know, want, like, need, understand** describe states, not actions. They don't take **-ing**.
feedback.bn: **know, want, like, need, understand** অবস্থা বোঝায়, কাজ নয় — এগুলোতে **-ing** বসে না।

options.text: I wanting a cup of tea.

feedback.en: **know, want, like, need, understand** take no **-ing** at all — and putting **is** in front wouldn't fix it either.
feedback.bn: **know, want, like, need, understand**-এ **-ing** বসে না — সামনে **is** বসালেও ঠিক হবে না।

options.text: I want a cup of tea.

feedback.en: Correct. This verb describes a state, not an action, so it stays in the present simple.
feedback.bn: ঠিক আছে। এই verb কাজ নয়, অবস্থা বোঝায় — তাই present simple-এ থাকে।
